title: Regional-bank deposit-flight NULL, revised: ALFRED point-in-time vintages + Clark-West nested test + un-floored loss sensitivity

fix1_alfred_point_in_time.problem: K1679 used the current (revised) FRED vintage — lookahead.
fix1_alfred_point_in_time.fix: Full ALFRED vintage history; signal reconstructed at the vintage current on each weekly release date; embargo uses the true realtime_start + 1d, not a +10d heuristic.

fix2_clark_west.problem: Baseline HAR nested in augmented model; standard DM/HLN biased toward NOT rejecting (toward the null).
fix2_clark_west.fix: Clark-West (2007) one-sided nested MSPE test on the two strongest K1679 cells, HAC lag = H, HLN-corrected.

fix3_unfloored_sensitivity.problem: Training-min positivity floor also clipped DSV/MSE cells that admit exact zeros (strongest dsv cell ~50/53 clipped).
fix3_unfloored_sensitivity.fix: Every MSE-based DM recomputed on raw un-floored forecasts.

method.baseline: OLS 1 + HAR(d,w,m) + SPY 21d RV + VIX level
method.oos: expanding refit, initial train 60%, embargo j+H<i
method.dm: NW HAC lag=H + HLN correction, t(n-1)
method.clark_west: CW(2007) one-sided nested MSPE, HAC lag=H + HLN
method.multiple_testing: Bonferroni + BH over primary family m=8
